exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix lease-

exec card --actor video-worker lease acquire encoder-slot-4 --ttl 25m
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/acquired.txt
! stderr .

! exec card --actor caption-worker lease release encoder-slot-4
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/held.txt
! exec card --actor caption-worker lease renew encoder-slot-4 --ttl 5m
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/held.txt

exec card --actor video-worker lease renew encoder-slot-4 --ttl 2h
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/renewed.txt
! stderr .
exec card --actor video-worker lease release encoder-slot-4
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/renewed.txt
! stderr .
exec card lease list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/empty.txt
! stderr .
! exec card lease show encoder-slot-4
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/missing.txt

-- golden/acquired.txt --
encoder-slot-4	video-worker	2026-07-12T12:00:00Z	2026-07-12T12:25:00Z
-- golden/held.txt --
error: lease "encoder-slot-4" is held by "video-worker" until 2026-07-12T12:25:00Z
-- golden/renewed.txt --
encoder-slot-4	video-worker	2026-07-12T12:00:00Z	2026-07-12T14:00:00Z
-- golden/missing.txt --
error: read lease "encoder-slot-4": lease not found
-- golden/empty.txt --
